# SecureFlow Web API risk corpus fixture

This fixture is generated locally from deterministic SecureFlow-owned recipes.
It contains 200 risky synthetic scenarios and 200 paired safe controls. It is a
known development corpus, not an independent holdout and not evidence of a
real-world vulnerability or human-superiority claim.

The canonical corpus is retained as `corpus.json`. Deterministic variants are
generated on demand and are intentionally not stored in this directory.
